request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, light drums, gentle strings, tender and slow, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shem and Japheth came out of the ark
Ham the father of Canaan
Noah planted a vineyard first
He drank wine and lay uncovered

[Chorus]
Cursed be Canaan he says
Lowest of slaves to his brothers
Blessed be the God of Shem
May Canaan be his slave

[Verse]
Ham saw his father's nakedness
Told his two brothers outside
Shem and Japheth took a garment
Walked in backward to cover him

[Chorus]
Cursed be Canaan he says
Lowest of slaves to his brothers
Blessed be the God of Shem
May Canaan be his slave

[Verse]
Sidon his firstborn and Heth
Jebusites and Amorites
Girgashites and Hivites
Clans scattered across the land

[Chorus]
Cursed be Canaan he says
Lowest of slaves to his brothers
Blessed be the God of Shem
May Canaan be his slave

[Outro]
From Sidon toward Gerar
As far as Gaza and Lasha
